summary: Enrichment of units 38-74 (23 units changed): modern names added beside the Sanskrit terms, Hindi given as Sanskrit term plus yani plus ordinary Hindi name. Plant identifications: standard 12 (liquorice, sandalwood, vetiver, nut-grass, sesame, grape, dry ginger, long pepper, black pepper, lodhra, pomegranate, lotus), probable 4 (cardamom, madhuka as liquorice, blue water lily, kshirivriksha fig group), disputed 3 (anjana, priyangu, samanga), unidentified 3 (dhanika, madhurasa, plus hrdgraha/hrdayapasarana as conditions). Diseases named: pravahika (dysentery), raktapitta, raktatisara, hikka, kasa, rectal prolapse. Units 46, 49, 73 left alone (garbled or low confidence).
